_tuning_notes: Snow leopard: grove + peaks, white coat, a bit tougher for the cold heights. Proves cold-biome species routing alongside the mountain gorilla. Phase 3: diet.hunts doubles as cage-trap bait (item form of the prey). RARITY: tier 'rare' supplies the spawn weight; group_size and nearby_cap are pinned here (1-2, cap 2). nearby_cap denies natural spawns when that many of this animal are already within 64 blocks — the fix for persistent CREATURE mobs accumulating forever.
